summary.zh: agenthelm dedupe --keep --retire-others 对 MCP 副本：已受管的条目由 agent-pack 退役（原 JSON 片段存入 0600 恢复目录、先逐字节备份 ~/.claude.json、原子改写、失败按字节回滚）；未受管的条目仍只给官方手工命令；证据不明的成员仍只读，跨客户端同指纹仍只是建议保留。
summary.en: agenthelm dedupe --keep --retire-others now retires managed MCP copies itself (original JSON fragment into a 0600 recovery directory, byte-exact backup of ~/.claude.json first, atomic edit, byte-exact rollback); unmanaged copies still get only the official manual command; members with unknown evidence stay read-only and cross-client same-fingerprint copies remain keep-recommended advice.
